commands.title: Relatório rápido do PC
commands.cmd: $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu=Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1; $disk=Get-PSDrive C; $ramLivre=[math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $ramTotal=[math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2); $diskLivre=[math]::Round($disk.Free/1GB,2); $diskTotal=[math]::Round(($disk.Used+$disk.Free)/1GB,2); $boot=[Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($os.LastBootUpTime); $uptime=New-TimeSpan -Start $boot -End (Get-Date); Write-Host "===== RELATORIO RAPIDO DO PC =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Computador: $env:COMPUTERNAME"; Write-Host "Windows: $($os.Caption) Build $($os.BuildNumber)"; Write-Host "CPU: $($cpu.Name)"; Write-Host "RAM: $ramLivre GB livre de $ramTotal GB"; Write-Host "Disco C: $diskLivre GB livre de $diskTotal GB"; Write-Host "Uptime: $($uptime.Days)d $($uptime.Hours)h"; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "Top 10 processos por RAM:" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,@{N="RAM(MB)";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host ""; if(Test-Connection 8.8.8.8 -Count 1 -Quiet){Write-Host "Internet: OK" -ForegroundColor Green}else{Write-Host "Internet: SEM CONEXAO" -ForegroundColor Red}

commands.title: Checkup Geral (Resumo Completo)

commands.title: Testar Internet (Múltiplos Servidores)
commands.cmd: Write-Host 'Testando conectividade...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; @('8.8.8.8','1.1.1.1','9.9.9.9','208.67.222.222') | ForEach-Object { $r = Test-Connection $_ -Count 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($r) { Write-Host "[$_] OK - $($r.ResponseTime)ms" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "[$_] FALHOU" -ForegroundColor Red } }

commands.title: Wi-Fi Redes Próximas
commands.cmd: netsh wlan show networks mode=bssid | Out-String

commands.title: Flush DNS + Renovar IP (DHCP)
commands.cmd: ipconfig /flushdns; ipconfig /release; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; ipconfig /renew; Write-Host '✅ DNS flush e IP renovado!' -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Portas Locais em Escuta
commands.cmd: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess,@{N='Programa';E={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Sort-Object LocalPort | Format-Table -AutoSize

commands.title: Testar Ollama (localhost:11434)
commands.cmd: try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:11434' -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; if($r.StatusCode -eq 200) { Write-Host '✅ Ollama ONLINE' -ForegroundColor Green; $m = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host "Modelos: $(($m.models | ForEach-Object { $_.name }) -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Cyan } } catch { Write-Host '❌ Ollama offline: ' $_.Exception.Message -ForegroundColor Red }

commands.title: Wi-Fi Força do Sinal (Barras)
commands.cmd: $s = [math]::Round((netsh wlan show interfaces | Select-String 'Sinal' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line -replace '[^0-9]','' }),0); $b = [math]::Ceiling($s/20); $bar = '█' * $b + '░' * (5 - $b); Write-Host "Sinal: $s% [$bar]" -ForegroundColor Cyan

commands.title: Trace Route (Tracert)
commands.cmd: $d = Read-Host 'Destino'; if($d) { tracert $d } else { Write-Host 'Informe o destino. Ex: tracert google.com' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Speed Test Mini (1MB Download)
commands.cmd: $t = Measure-Command { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://speedtest.tele2.net/1MB.zip' -OutFile "$env:TEMP\speedtest.tmp" -UseBasicParsing }; $mb = 1; $s = [math]::Round($t.TotalSeconds,2); $mbps = [math]::Round(($mb * 8) / $s,2); Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\speedtest.tmp" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Velocidade estimada: ~$mbps Mbps (download de 1MB em ${s}s)" -ForegroundColor Cyan

commands.title: Backup Completo do Registro
commands.cmd: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "registry-backup-$date.reg"; reg export HKLM $backupFile /y; reg export HKCU $backupFile /y; Write-Host "✅ Backup do registro salvo em: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Backup de Drivers Instalados
commands.cmd: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups\Drivers"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; pnputil /export-driver * $backupDir; Write-Host "✅ Drivers exportados para: $backupDir" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Backup de Programas Instalados
commands.cmd: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "programas-instalados-$date.txt"; Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\* | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName } | Select-Object DisplayName,DisplayVersion,Publisher,InstallDate | Sort-Object DisplayName | Out-File -FilePath $backupFile -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "✅ Lista salva em: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Backup de Configuração de Rede
commands.cmd: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "network-config-$date.txt"; netsh interface dump | Out-File -FilePath $backupFile -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "✅ Config de rede salva em: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Backup de Chaves de Registro Específicas
commands.cmd: $KeyPath = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion"; $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $keyName = $KeyPath -replace '\\','_'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "registry-$keyName-$date.reg"; reg export $KeyPath $backupFile /y; Write-Host "✅ Chave $KeyPath exportada para: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Temperatura CPU (Leitura Direta)
commands.cmd: try { $temp = Get-WmiObject MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature -Namespace 'root/wmi' | ForEach-Object { [math]::Round(($_.CurrentTemperature - 2732) / 10, 1) }; Write-Host "Temperatura CPU: $temp °C" -ForegroundColor $(if($temp -gt 80){'Red'}elseif($temp -gt 60){'Yellow'}else{'Green'}) } catch { Write-Host '⚠️ Sensor de temperatura não disponível via WMI. Use HWMonitor ou OpenHardwareMonitor.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Monitoramento Contínuo de Temperatura
commands.cmd: for($i=1; $i -le 10; $i++) { try { $temp = Get-WmiObject MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature -Namespace 'root/wmi' | ForEach-Object { [math]::Round(($_.CurrentTemperature - 2732) / 10, 1) }; Write-Host "[$i] CPU: $temp °C - $(Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss')" -ForegroundColor $(if($temp -gt 80){'Red'}elseif($temp -gt 60){'Yellow'}else{'Green'}) } catch { Write-Host 'Leitura indisponível' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5 }

commands.title: Monitorar Temperatura GPU
commands.cmd: try { $gpu = Get-WmiObject Win32_VideoController; foreach($g in $gpu) { Write-Host "GPU: $($g.Name)" -ForegroundColor Cyan; $temp = Get-WmiObject -Namespace 'root/openhardwaremonitor' -Class Sensor -Filter "SensorType='Temperature'" -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*GPU*' -or $_.Name -like '*Video*' } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Value; if($temp) { Write-Host "  Temperatura: $temp °C" -ForegroundColor $(if($temp -gt 85){'Red'}elseif($temp -gt 70){'Yellow'}else{'Green'}) } else { Write-Host '  Sensor indisponível' -ForegroundColor Yellow } } } catch { Write-Host '⚠️ Instale Open Hardware Monitor para leitura GPU' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Alerta Temperatura Alta
commands.cmd: $threshold = 85; try { $temp = Get-WmiObject MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature -Namespace 'root/wmi' | ForEach-Object { [math]::Round(($_.CurrentTemperature - 2732) / 10, 1) }; if($temp -ge $threshold) { Write-Host "⚠️ ALERTA: Temperatura CRÍTICA ($temp °C)" -ForegroundColor Red; [System.Console]::Beep(1000, 500); [System.Console]::Beep(1000, 500) } else { Write-Host "✅ Temperatura normal: $temp °C" -ForegroundColor Green } } catch { Write-Host 'Sensor indisponível' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Listar Todos os Drivers Instalados
commands.cmd: Get-WmiObject Win32_PnPSignedDriver | Where-Object {$_.DriverDate -ne $null} | Select-Object DeviceName,DriverVersion,Manufacturer,@{N='Data';E={[Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($_.DriverDate).ToString('dd/MM/yyyy')}} | Sort-Object DeviceName | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap

commands.title: Atualizar Drivers via Windows Update
commands.cmd: pnputil /scan-devices; pnputil /install-device *; Write-Host "✅ Busca e instalação de drivers iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Reinstalar Driver de Dispositivo
commands.cmd: $DeviceName = 'Audio'; $device = Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object {$_.FriendlyName -like "*$DeviceName*"} | Select-Object -First 1; if($device) { Disable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $device.InstanceId -Confirm:$false; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Enable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $device.InstanceId -Confirm:$false; Write-Host "✅ Driver de '$DeviceName' reinstalado!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Dispositivo '$DeviceName' não encontrado" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Rollback de Driver (Versão Anterior)
commands.cmd: $DeviceName = 'Video'; $device = Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object {$_.FriendlyName -like "*$DeviceName*"} | Select-Object -First 1; if($device) { pnputil /enum-drivers | Select-String -Pattern $device.InstanceId -Context 2; Write-Host "⚠️ Use 'pnputil /delete-driver <oem#.inf>' para remover driver antigo" -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Dispositivo '$DeviceName' não encontrado" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Exportar Lista Completa de Drivers
commands.cmd: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "drivers-list-$date.csv"; Get-WmiObject Win32_PnPSignedDriver | Where-Object {$_.DriverDate -ne $null} | Select-Object DeviceName,DriverVersion,Manufacturer,DriverDate | Export-Csv -Path $backupFile -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "✅ Lista exportada: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Listar Todos os Apps UWP
commands.cmd: Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers | Select-Object Name,Version,Architecture,InstallLocation | Sort-Object Name | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap

commands.title: Reinstalar Todos Apps Padrão
commands.cmd: Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers | Foreach { Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register "$($_.InstallLocation)\AppXManifest.xml" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "✅ Apps UWP reinstalados!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Reset de App UWP Específico
commands.cmd: $AppName = 'Microsoft.WindowsCalculator'; $app = Get-AppxPackage | Where-Object {$_.Name -like "*$AppName*"} | Select-Object -First 1; if($app) { Get-AppxPackage $app.Name | Reset-AppxPackage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "✅ App '$AppName' resetado!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ App '$AppName' não encontrado" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Limpar Cache de Todos os Apps UWP
commands.cmd: $appData = $env:LOCALAPPDATA; $packages = Get-ChildItem "$appData\Packages" -Directory; foreach($pkg in $packages) { $cachePath = Join-Path $pkg.FullName "AppCache"; if(Test-Path $cachePath) { Remove-Item $cachePath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $tempPath = Join-Path $pkg.FullName "TempState"; if(Test-Path $tempPath) { Remove-Item $tempPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Host "✅ Cache de apps UWP limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Diagnóstico de Apps UWP
commands.cmd: Write-Host "=== DIAGNÓSTICO UWP ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; $total = (Get-AppxPackage).Count; $corrupted = Get-AppxPackage | Where-Object { $_.InstallLocation -eq $null }; Write-Host "Total de apps: $total" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "Apps corrompidos: $($corrupted.Count)" -ForegroundColor $(if($corrupted.Count -gt 0){'Red'}else{'Green'}); if($corrupted.Count -gt 0) { $corrupted | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $($_.Name)" -ForegroundColor Yellow } }

commands.title: Otimizar TRIM (Todos os Drives)
commands.cmd: $drives = Get-PhysicalDisk | Where-Object {$_.MediaType -eq 'SSD' -or $_.MediaType -eq 'Unspecified'}; foreach($drive in $drives) { $driveLetter = (Get-Partition -DiskNumber $drive.DeviceId | Where-Object {$_.DriveLetter}).DriveLetter; if($driveLetter) { Write-Host "Otimizando drive $driveLetter..." -ForegroundColor Yellow; Optimize-Volume -DriveLetter $driveLetter -ReTrim -Verbose } }; Write-Host "✅ TRIM executado nos SSDs!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Verificar Saúde Completa do SSD
commands.cmd: Get-PhysicalDisk | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "=== $($_.FriendlyName) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Tipo: $($_.MediaType)" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "Saúde: $($_.HealthStatus)" -ForegroundColor $(if($_.HealthStatus -eq 'Healthy'){'Green'}else{'Red'}); Write-Host "Tamanho: $([math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)) GB" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "Status: $($_.OperationalStatus)" -ForegroundColor White; if($_.HealthStatus -ne 'Healthy') { Write-Host "⚠️ DISCO COM PROBLEMAS!" -ForegroundColor Red } }

commands.title: Histórico de Uso do SSD (SMART)
commands.cmd: Get-PhysicalDisk | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "=== $($_.FriendlyName) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "⚠️ Dados SMART disponíveis via Get-PhysicalDisk. Use CrystalDiskInfo para análise detalhada." -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Verificar Alinhamento de Partições
commands.cmd: Get-Partition | ForEach-Object { $offset = $_.Offset; $aligned = ($offset % 1MB) -eq 0; Write-Host "$($_.DriveLetter):) Offset: $offset bytes - $(if($aligned){'✅ Alinhado'}else{'⚠️ NÃO Alinhado!'}" -ForegroundColor $(if($aligned){'Green'}else{'Red'}) }

commands.title: Otimizar Windows para SSD
commands.cmd: fsutil behavior query disabledeletenotify | Select-String '0' | ForEach-Object { Write-Host '✅ TRIM já está habilitado' -ForegroundColor Green }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' -Name 'PrefetchParameters' -Value 3 -Force; Write-Host '✅ Prefetch otimizado para SSD' -ForegroundColor Green; Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'Microsoft\Windows\Defrag\ScheduledDefrag' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '✅ Desfragmentação automática desativada' -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Monitorar Uso de CPU, RAM e Disco
commands.cmd: for($i=1; $i -le 5; $i++) { $cpu = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average).Average; $ram = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $ramPct = [math]::Round((($ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize - $ram.FreePhysicalMemory) / $ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize) * 100, 1); $disk = Get-PSDrive C; $diskPct = [math]::Round(($disk.Used / ($disk.Used + $disk.Free)) * 100, 1); Write-Host "[$i] CPU: $cpu% | RAM: $ramPct% | Disco: $diskPct%" -ForegroundColor $(if($cpu -gt 80 -or $ramPct -gt 80){'Red'}else{'Green'}); Start-Sleep -Seconds 3 }

commands.title: Exportar Relatório Completo (HTML)
commands.cmd:
$reportDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Relatorios"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $reportFile = Join-Path $reportDir "relatorio-$date.html"; $os = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu = Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1; $ram = [math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $totalRam = [math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2); $disk = Get-PSDrive C; $html = @" Relatório do Sistema

Relatório do PC - $(Get-Date -Format 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')

Informações Gerais

  • Windows: $($os.Caption) Build $($os.BuildNumber)
  • CPU: $($cpu.Name)
  • RAM: $ram GB livre de $totalRam GB
  • Disco C: $([math]::Round($disk.Free/1GB,2)) GB livre
"@; $html | Out-File -FilePath $reportFile -Encoding UTF8; Start-Process $reportFile; Write-Host "✅ Relatório gerado: $reportFile" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Agendar Limpeza Diária Automática
commands.cmd: $taskName = 'MestrePC-LimpezaDiaria'; $script = 'Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Clear-RecycleBin -Force -EA 0'; $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'PowerShell.exe' -Argument "-NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command \"$script\""; $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At 3am; $principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -RunLevel Highest; Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Principal $principal -Force; Write-Host "✅ Tarefa '$taskName' agendada diariamente às 03:00!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Enviar Status para Discord (Webhook)
commands.cmd: $WebhookUrl = $env:MESTRE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK; if(-not $WebhookUrl) { Write-Host '⚠️ Defina MESTRE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK nas variáveis de ambiente' -ForegroundColor Yellow; return }; $os = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average).Average; $ram = [math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $body = @{ content = "**Mestre do PC - Status**`n🖥️ PC: $env:COMPUTERNAME`n⚙️ CPU: $cpu%`n💾 RAM Livre: $ram GB`n🪟 Windows: $($os.Caption)" } | ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $WebhookUrl -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; Write-Host "✅ Status enviado para Discord!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Enviar Notificação para Teams (Webhook)
commands.cmd: $WebhookUrl = $env:MESTRE_TEAMS_WEBHOOK; if(-not $WebhookUrl) { Write-Host '⚠️ Defina MESTRE_TEAMS_WEBHOOK nas variáveis de ambiente' -ForegroundColor Yellow; return }; $body = @{ text = "🔔 **Mestre do PC**`nStatus do sistema: $env:COMPUTERNAME`nData: $(Get-Date -Format 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')" } | ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $WebhookUrl -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; Write-Host "✅ Notificação enviada para Teams!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Listar Locais Comuns do PC
commands.cmd: $locais = @(@{Nome='Desktop'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')}, @{Nome='Downloads'; Caminho=(Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads')}, @{Nome='Documentos'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyDocuments')}, @{Nome='Imagens'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyPictures')}, @{Nome='Musica'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyMusic')}, @{Nome='Videos'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyVideos')}, @{Nome='TEMP do Usuario'; Caminho=$env:TEMP}, @{Nome='TEMP do Windows'; Caminho=(Join-Path $env:windir 'Temp')}, @{Nome='Program Files'; Caminho=$env:ProgramFiles}, @{Nome='Program Files (x86)'; Caminho=${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}}, @{Nome='AppData Local'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('LocalApplicationData')}, @{Nome='AppData Roaming'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('ApplicationData')}); $locais | ForEach-Object { $p = $_.Caminho; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { $itens = (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Force -EA 0 | Measure-Object).Count; [PSCustomObject]@{ Local = $_.Nome; Caminho = $p; Itens = $itens; Existe = 'Sim' } } else { [PSCustomObject]@{ Local = $_.Nome; Caminho = $p; Itens = 0; Existe = 'Nao' } } } | Sort-Object Local | Format-Table -AutoSize

commands.title: Testar DNS (Google + Cloudflare)
commands.cmd: Write-Host '=== Teste de DNS ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; @('google.com','cloudflare.com','microsoft.com') | ForEach-Object { try { $r = Resolve-DnsName $_ -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "[$_] OK - $($r[0].IPAddress)" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host "[$_] FALHOU" -ForegroundColor Red } }

commands.title: Testar HTTPS (Porta 443)
commands.cmd: Write-Host '=== Teste HTTPS (443) ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; @('google.com','cloudflare.com','microsoft.com') | ForEach-Object { $r = Test-NetConnection $_ -Port 443 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if($r.TcpTestSucceeded) { Write-Host "[$_] HTTPS OK" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "[$_] HTTPS FALHOU" -ForegroundColor Red } }

commands.title: Instalar .NET SDK 8 (Microsoft)

commands.title: Instalar .NET Runtime 8 (Microsoft)
commands.cmd: winget install Microsoft.DotNet.Runtime.8 --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; Write-Host "✅ Instalação do .NET Runtime 8 iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Instalar Visual Studio Build Tools 2022 (Microsoft)
commands.cmd: winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; Write-Host "✅ Instalação do Visual Studio Build Tools iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Instalar Windows SDK (Microsoft)
commands.cmd: winget install Microsoft.WindowsSDK --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; Write-Host "✅ Instalação do Windows SDK iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Instalar Azure CLI (Microsoft)
commands.cmd: winget install Microsoft.AzureCLI --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; Write-Host "✅ Instalação do Azure CLI iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Instalar GitHub CLI

commands.title: Instalar WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux)
commands.cmd: wsl --install; Write-Host "✅ Instalação do WSL iniciada! Reinicie o computador para concluir." -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Instalar Rust (Rustup)

commands.title: Instalar Go (Golang)
commands.cmd: winget install GoLang.Go --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; Write-Host "✅ Instalação do Go iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Instalar Java JDK 21 (Eclipse Temurin)
commands.cmd: winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.21.JDK --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; Write-Host "✅ Instalação do Java JDK 21 iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Encerrar Processo
commands.cmd: Stop-Process -Name "{{NOME}}" -Force -EA 0; if ($?) { Write-Host "✅ Processo {{NOME}} encerrado com sucesso!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Processo {{NOME}} não encontrado ou já encerrado." -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Desativar Serviço
commands.cmd: Set-Service -Name "{{NOME_SERVICO}}" -StartupType Disabled -EA 0; Stop-Service -Name "{{NOME_SERVICO}}" -Force -EA 0; if ($?) { Write-Host "✅ Serviço {{NOME_SERVICO}} desativado!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Serviço {{NOME_SERVICO}} não encontrado." -ForegroundColor Yellow }

commands.title: Desinstalar Atualização Específica
commands.cmd: wusa /uninstall /kb:{{NUMERO_KB}} /quiet /norestart; Write-Host "Substitua NUMERO_KB pelo KB desejado." -ForegroundColor Yellow

commands.title: Atualizar Driver por Hardware ID
commands.cmd: pnputil /add-driver "{{CAMINHO_INF}}" /install; Write-Host "Substitua CAMINHO.inf pelo caminho do driver." -ForegroundColor Yellow

commands.title: Ver informações de um modelo Ollama
Criar modelo Ollama a partir de Modelfile
Bloquear IP Específico no Firewall
commands.cmd: New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Block {{IP_BLOQUEIO}}" -Direction Inbound -Action Block -RemoteAddress {{IP_BLOQUEIO}}; Write-Host "✅ IP {{IP_BLOQUEIO}} bloqueado!" -ForegroundColor Green

commands.title: Remover Regra de Bloqueio de IP
Buscar CVEs por Hotfix (NVD)
commands.cmd: Start-Process "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/search/results?query={{KB}}"; Write-Host 'Abrindo NVD para pesquisa...' -ForegroundColor Cyan

commands.title: chmod 644 (Dono: RW, Outros: R)
commands.cmd: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /inheritance:r; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "$env:USERNAME:(M)"; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "Todos:(R)"; Write-Host '✅ chmod 644 aplicado' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

commands.title: chmod 755 (Dono: RWX, Outros: RX)
commands.cmd: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /inheritance:r; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "$env:USERNAME:(F)"; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "Todos:(RX)"; Write-Host '✅ chmod 755 aplicado' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

commands.title: chmod 600 (Apenas Dono: RW)
